sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:187

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:187:1
items.html:
The self is clothed both in the ten Sefirot called “world” and in the ten Sefirot called “Nefashot and Ruchin.” That is, the matter of externality and internality is discerned only in the vessels alone, in that the ten Sefirot in each world, their vessels are called internality, and the firmaments and the angels in each world, their vessels are called externality. But the self in them, both the self in the ten Sefirot and the self in the worlds, both of them are the discernment of internality. And further on Rav Chaim Vital is in doubt about the self in the discernment of the worlds, whether perhaps it too is reckoned as the discernment of externality.
And one must remember here what the ARI wrote above, page 1988, item 177, that the principal part of internality and externality is discerned only in the ten Sefirot in each world, for the three vessels KHB, called brain, bones, sinews, are called by the name internality, and the two vessels ZON, called flesh and skin, are called by the name externality. But also the souls of human beings are called by the name internality, since they come from couplings of the inner vessels of the ten Sefirot, and likewise the angels and the firmaments are called by the name externality, since they come from the couplings of the external vessels of the ten Sefirot. See there well, and in the Inner Light.
